name: The Ritz Carlton Perth
insider_take: Perth's crown jewel sits majestically on Elizabeth Quay, where luxury meets the Swan River in Australia's sunniest capital city.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Perth is the city's first ultra-luxury hotel, featuring the southern hemisphere's highest Club Lounge on the 24th floor. Built on reclaimed land at Elizabeth Quay, it offers unparalleled views of the Swan River and is directly connected to Perth's cultural precinct via pedestrian bridges.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room during Perth's famous sunset hours – the city boasts more sunny days than any other Australian capital, making for spectacular golden hour photography from your suite.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's complimentary Tesla transfers to nearby attractions, and explore Elizabeth Quay's floating boardwalks at night when the LED light installations create a magical waterfront experience. The hotel's proximity to Optus Stadium means you're perfectly positioned for major sporting events and concerts.
pros: Premium location in Perth's cultural and business district
Exceptional Ritz Carlton service standards and luxury amenities
Modern accommodations with sophisticated Australian design
Access to exclusive Marriott STARS Program benefits
cons: Urban location may not suit guests seeking beachfront access
